Specifically, the script filtered rows where all yearly values (2001-2010) exceeded 35% of GDP but did not account for inconsistencies in the data such as aggregate regions (like "East Asia & Pacific") instead of individual countries. These entries (e.g., "East Asia & Pacific (IDA & IBRD countries)," "East Asia & Pacific (excluding high income)") are not independent countries and should be excluded.

Additionally, using raw column names (e.g., years as strings) without verifying data formatting and cleaning could result in misalignment and unintentional errors in numerical comparisons. The incorrect final answer included non-countries and incorrect entries due to insufficient data preprocessing and validation.
